answerType.description:
Drives shape validation for `pointValues`. Must match the referenced
signal template's answer type — mismatch surfaces as an
`INVALID_POINT_VALUES` 422 at write time rather than a silent
compute failure later.

pointValues.description:
Point-value mapping for one rule. The shape varies by the answer type of the
referenced signal template — exactly one of `true`/`false`, `ranges`, or `choices`
is populated.

choices.description: Used by `list` answer types. Map of allowed list value → points awarded if present in the answer.

false.description: Points awarded when a boolean signal answers `false`. Used by `boolean` answer types.

mode.description:
Optional. Controls how a `list` rule combines matched choices. Defaults
to `additive` (sum matched, clamp to highest single choice) — the v1
behaviour. Other modes:

* `best-match` — award only the highest-scoring matched choice.
* `contains-all` — award `max(choices)` only if every configured choice appears.
* `contains-none` — award `max(choices)` only if none of the configured choices appear.
* `exact-match` — award `sum(choices)` only when the answer set equals the configured set exactly.

ranges.description: Used by `number`, `percentage`, and `currency` answer types. Upper bound is exclusive.

true.description: Points awarded when a boolean signal answers `true`. Used by `boolean` answer types.
